PLAN: Preserve R957 as the best design and spend the final solve on one isolated, conservative C6-column energy reduction; keep it only if blend purity and revenue survive.
R957 scores 1.236 with root 50/5/5.5/0.5, C5 finisher T 60/8/12/0.3, and C6 finisher B 35/5/3/0.3. Reducing T reflux to 7.5 lost $81M/yr revenue for only $7.4M/yr savings; root height 45 was slightly worse. R998 showed the C6 purity cliff lies between B 35/5/3 and 30/4.5/3, so avoid another large cut. Final test: only B reflux 5.0 to 4.8 at fixed height, boil-up and pressure. This needs one new solve, leaves the other columns cached, and R957 remains the fallback if purity or economics worsen.
